title: In-process Analysis Core Package
summary: Implemented the analysis package and CLI proof, then migrated the Quality Studio API generic named-sensor execution route to the same in-process facade while preserving its HTTP contract. The core is useful without the UI. Repository extraction is explicitly deferred pending operator criteria.

decision.recommendation: Do not extract the analysis core repository now. Publish and consume the package from this repository first; reconsider extraction when independent cadence, stable semantic versioning, release ownership, and public-repository policy justify the cross-repository cost.

responses.question: Is the analysis core useful without the UI studio?
responses.answer: Yes. Agent Studio pipeline steps (AGT-2655), quality-cli, and CI can run named analyses over an existing checkout and consume Quality Studio finding envelopes in process.

responses.question: Should the core be extracted into its own repository now?
responses.answer: No. Keep the package in this repository for the first slice and wait for an explicit operator decision against the documented extraction criteria.

completed: publishable analysis package and stable facade
